_comment: The stance dial, exhaustive. Generated by tests/go_fixtures.py; do not edit by hand. `describe` is recorded as a SERIALISED string rather than as an object because field order is part of the contract and only bytes carry it.

preset_blurbs.off: No calls, ever. The gate, the solver and the simulator all still work -- this turns off opinions, not the tool.
preset_blurbs.consultant: Speaks when spoken to, about what the gate already flagged.
preset_blurbs.second-opinion: Volunteers observations and looks at neighbouring cards. Still writes nothing.
preset_blurbs.collaborator: Questions the deck's axis and batches edits for one approval. Never writes a rationale -- that rule has no stance above it.
